summary: Chat with an AI model in an editor tab. Requires the AI Core addon and one AI backend addon.
description: Adds a chat tab with streaming, formatted replies, a list of saved chats and a choice of backend. It never reads or edits your project; the model sees only what you type. Messages stay on the device with AI Agent Local, and go to that provider's service with a cloud backend. The chat screen is adapted from Jan (Apache-2.0).
